patterns.note: Content is presented in a narrow, centered column, mimicking a printed book or technical manual, set against a subtle, full-bleed graph paper background.

A distinctive pixelated monospace font is used for primary headings, contrasted with a classic serif font for body text and a standard monospace for labels and code-like elements, creating a retro-technical aesthetic.
The design is largely monochromatic (black text on white background) with a single, consistent bright blue used exclusively for all technical line-art illustrations and occasional text accents.
No scroll-triggered motion; the design relies on static hierarchy, with content simply scrolling into and out of view like a continuous document.
Detailed technical illustrations are integrated directly into the text flow, often spanning the full content width, acting as visual explanations for the surrounding paragraphs.

technique_notes: The page uses a fixed-width content container centered on a repeating grid background pattern that scrolls with the content, giving the impression of a digital blueprint or notebook.
Typography is a deliberate mix of a retro pixelated/monospace font for display elements and a traditional serif font for long-form reading, establishing a unique brand voice.
All illustrative elements are rendered as clean, blueprint-style line art in a single, vibrant accent blue, providing visual interest and clarity without overwhelming the text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, pixelated display headings (~4-5x body) with a clear hierarchy down to readable serif body text and smaller monospace labels, creating a structured, manual-like feel.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with ample whitespace around text blocks and illustrations, contributing to a clean, readable document aesthetic.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its strong retro-technical aesthetic, achieved through the unique combination of pixelated monospace typography, blueprint-style line art illustrations in a single accent color, and a graph paper background. It feels like a meticulously crafted digital technical manual from a bygone era.
